title: AC1.1 - Verify login form is available at Signup/Login page

steps.step: Verify email input field is present
steps.expected: Email input field is visible and accessible

steps.step: Verify password input field is present
steps.expected: Password input field is visible and accessible
Submit/Login button is visible and enabled

title: AC2.1 - Successful login with valid credentials

steps.expected: Email is populated in the email field
Password is populated in the password field
User session is active and profile visible

title: AC3.1 - Error displayed for incorrect password

steps.expected: Password field filled with wrong password
Error message 'Incorrect credentials' or similar is displayed

steps.step: Verify user is not logged in
steps.expected: User remains on login page, session not created

title: AC3.2 - Error displayed for unregistered email

steps.expected: Email is populated in the field
Error message indicating user not found or invalid credentials is displayed

steps.step: Verify user is not logged in

title: AC4.1 - Validation warning when both fields are empty

steps.expected: Required field messages appear for empty fields
User remains on login page, no redirect occurs

title: AC4.2 - Validation warning when email field is empty

steps.expected: 'Required field' or 'Email is required' message is displayed

title: AC4.3 - Validation warning when password field is empty

steps.expected: Email is populated in the field
'Required field' or 'Password is required' message is displayed
